purpose: Bounded transport and observation projection for hosted Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI contracts.

transport.correlation: correlation_id equals request.operation_id and response correlation metadata
transport.deadline: positive bounded monotonic deadline; elapsed exchanges are rejected
transport.retry: at most five attempts and only transport failures before an authority response
transport.ambiguous: unknown, ambiguous, and indeterminate outcomes are blocking and never promoted or retried

limitations: Deterministic fake-server qualification is not hosted success.
No network, credentials, remote authority, durable authority mutation, or live hosted check is performed.
